verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers SvelteKit's SSR/SPA/SSG modes, reactivity primitives, and CLI tooling, but nothing addresses compiling a standalone Svelte component for mounting into an existing non-Svelte server-rendered HTML page (e.g., a `mount()`/embed API or progressive-enhancement guide). No first-party or community citation confirms this specific drop-in/embed workflow, so the applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
